Susan Shirk is a former U.S. government official and one of America’s leading scholars of modern Chinese politics. She is a research professor in the School of Global Policy and Strategy at the University of California, San Diego, where she formerly chaired the 21st Century China Center. She first traveled to China in 1971, with the Committee of Concerned Asian Scholars.
